the blase traveler refers to the ocean he has crossed as `the pond'
the benefits of his worldly wisdom
worldly-wise: experienced in and wise to the ways of the world
worldwide: spanning or extending throughout the entire world
involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
neither national nor continental but planetary
the shrewdest political and ecumenical comment of our time"- Christopher Morley
worm-eaten: infested with or damaged (as if eaten) by worms
worm-shaped: resembling a worm; long and thin and cylindrical
wormy: infested with or damaged (as if eaten) by worms
worn: affected by wear; damaged by long use
the worn pockets on the jacket
showing the wearing effects of overwork or care or suffering
looking careworn as she bent over her mending
her face was drawn and haggard from sleeplessness
that raddled but still noble face
shocked to see the worn look of his handsome young face"- Charles Dickens
worn-out: drained of energy or effectiveness; extremely tired; completely exhausted
the day's shopping left her exhausted
the trembling of his played out limbs
worried: afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief
distressed about her son's leaving home
one last worried check of the sleeping children
mentally upset over possible misfortune or danger etc
not used to a city and worried about small things
worrisome: not reassuring; tending to cause anxiety
causing distress or worry or anxiety
lived in heroic if something distressful isolation
a revelation that was most perturbing
worsened: changed for the worse in health or fitness
troubled by the worsened economic conditions
worshipped: regarded with deep or rapturous love (especially as if for a god)
worthful: having worth or merit or value
worthless: would do something as despicable as murder
the vile development of slavery appalled them
worthwhile: sufficiently valuable to justify the investment of time or interest
would-be: unfulfilled or frustrated in realizing an ambition
woven: made or constructed by interlacing threads or strips of material or other elements into a whole
the incidents woven into the story
folk songs woven into a symphony
woefully: in an unfortunate or deplorable manner
wolfishly: in the manner of a wolf
wonderingly: in a curious and questioning manner
they turned their heads questioningly, as if awaiting further instructions
wordlessly: he sat mutely next to her
worriedly: `I wonder what to do,' she said worriedly
he paused worriedly before calling the bank
worryingly: in a manner to cause worry
worthily: in a worthy manner; with worthiness
